dimensions.source: Gymrek et al., Science 2013, Identifying personal genomes by surname inference
dimensions.limitations: Surname inference was reported as successful in 109 of 911 evaluated cases, approximately 11.9 percent. The technique is primarily applicable to male records through Y-chromosome STR information and depends on genealogical-database coverage and associated metadata. Surname inference is an identity-linkage mechanism and does not imply universal or automatic full re-identification.
